user_request: Reliable printed reference + existing hub/needle network + independent calibration controls; establish correct reading recovery before model/deployment selection
scope: Offline visual-reference replacement experiment, no training or hardware changes

frozen_networks.all_model_permissions: UNCHANGED, visual print does not replace hub or needle evidence

reference_definition.bottom: Centroid of lower striped-ball printed logo
reference_definition.vector: Bottom to top, image x-right/y-down, clockwise positive
reference_definition.zero_reference: D_002, exactly the same physical anchor definition
reference_definition.unavailable: Explicit missing/occluded/ambiguous, never pressure- or needle-derived
reference_definition.source: AI visual annotation from original face pixels; no algorithmic pose readouts or pressure used to choose points
reference_definition.evidence_grade: Visual diagnostic reference with uncertainty, NOT certified pose ground truth or automatic128ROI inference
reference_definition.view_limit: Two-point image direction is not perspective correction or calibrated yaw/pitch

data.calibration_candidates: D/E/F, first two planned frontal slots per each6-image pressure block;48images selected before scores
data.canonical_and_originals: Unchanged; new visual references stored as separate sidecars

primary_four_cells: Visual print reference + frozen old calibration
Visual print reference + new train-only calibration
controls.matched_calibration_control: Additionally fit old/new reference calibration on the same admissible DEF observations to separate training-subset changes
controls.common_evaluation_subset: Report paired-reference-available subset in addition to all59; never drop missing references from main denominator
controls.calibration_rule: Original linear fit of equal-pressure median visual needle-minus-reference angles; PSI support2.5..12 only, no clamping/extrapolation or G fitting
controls.missing_visual_reference: Reject, no hidden old-ring fallback in primary four cells

metrics: Valid and rejected counts by scene
Correct output coverage at predeclared descriptive0.25/0.5/1psi bands
New outputs and withdrawn outputs byID
New wrong outputs and lost correct outputs at each band
success_interpretation: A useful visual-reference substitution may justify future automatic landmark work; it is never itself evidence of automatic128ROI robustness or deployment fit
stop: No reliable print evidence or no correct-output benefit: retain old reader, do not change G thresholds/labels by PSI to manufacture gains
no_actions: No change to concurrent UI/REF projects
